description: A tall bottle with a dark screw cap sits upright on the table in front of both hands. The left hand reaches in from the left to grasp the bottle and tip it slightly sideways, while the right hand comes in from the right to grip the cap and twist it counterclockwise until it comes off; the right hand sets the cap down on the tabletop as the left hand brings the now-open bottle back upright as a left-hand object.
